title: Preference Leakage: A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-Judge
authors_zh: Dawei Li, Renliang Sun, Yue Huang, Ming Zhong, Bohan Jiang, Jiawei Han, Xiangliang Zhang, Wei Wang, Huan Liu
paper_type_zh: LLM-as-a-judge 的合成数据污染、谱系偏差与评测审计研究
best_for_zh: 使用合成偏好数据和 LLM judge、需审计模型谱系偏差的研究者。
one_line: judge relatedness bias and released synthesis/judgment data
揭示生成器与 judge 的谱系关联会使 judge 偏向相关学生模型。
why: It offers a concrete audit surface or failure-mode dataset for Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 candidate: the central contribution audits contamination, verifier or judge failure, reward hacking, or evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Synthetic data and LLM-as-a-judge are often combined, but evaluation can be contaminated when the data generator and judge are related. A judge may favor a student trained on its own, inherited, or same-family generator data, inflating reported quality without obvious benchmark overlap.

The paper names this failure preference leakage, defines three generator--judge relatedness conditions, and measures the induced favoritism with a preference leakage score across controlled training and LLM-judge evaluations.

合成数据和 LLM-as-a-judge 常被联用，但生成器与 judge 有关联时会产生污染：judge 可能偏向由同一模型、继承模型或同家族模型生成数据训练出的学生模型，在没有明显 benchmark 重叠时虚高质量结论。

论文将此失效命名为 preference leakage，定义三类生成器—judge 关联，并通过受控训练和 LLM judge 评测，以 preference leakage score 量化由此产生的偏袒。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Preference leakage is a contamination mechanism in which related generator and judge LLMs transfer a preference to the generator-trained student. The paper operationalizes relatedness as same model, inheritance, or same family and compares judge outcomes using a preference leakage score. It releases code and data for the study, rather than proposing a new reward model; the central audit object is the generator--student--judge lineage and its resulting pairwise verdict bias.
Preference leakage 是一种污染机制：有关联的生成器和 judge LLM 将偏好传递给由该生成器数据训练的学生。论文将关联操作化为同一模型、继承关系或同家族，并以 preference leakage score 比较 judge 结果。它公开研究代码和数据，而非提出新奖励模型；核心审计对象是生成器—学生—judge 谱系及其造成的成对判决偏差。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Specify lineage conditions. Pair a synthetic-data generator with an LLM judge as the same model, inheritance-related, or same-family.
  1. Create comparable students. Train student models on the corresponding synthetic data while holding the evaluation setup fixed.
  1. Measure judge favoritism. Evaluate responses on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval 2.0, and compute the preference leakage score from judge outcomes.
  1. Stress the mechanism. Vary synthetic-data mixing, relatedness, learning settings, model size, question type, and judgment dimension; analyze whether judges recognize related students. Code and study data are released in the official repository.

1. 指定谱系条件。 将合成数据生成器与 LLM judge 配成同一模型、继承关联或同家族。
  1. 构造可比学生。 用相应合成数据训练学生模型，同时固定评测设置。
  1. 测量 judge 偏袒。 在 Arena-Hard 和 AlpacaEval 2.0 评测回答，根据 judge 结果计算 preference leakage score。
  1. 压力测试机制。 改变合成数据混合、关联、学习设置、模型尺寸、问题类型和判决维度，并分析 judge 能否识别相关学生；官方仓库公开代码与研究数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim. Generator--judge relatedness produces systematic favorable judgments. Setup. The paper evaluates related students on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval 2.0 and reports the preference leakage score under controlled relation types. Result. The average score is 23.6% for the same-model condition, 19.3%/22.3% for two inheritance conditions, 8.9% for same-family same-series, and 2.8% even for different-series family models (Table 2). Boundary. These are measured configurations, not a universal correction factor for closed model lineages.

主张。 生成器—judge 关联会造成系统性偏袒。设置。 论文在 Arena-Hard 与 AlpacaEval 2.0 上评测相关学生，并在受控关系类型下报告 preference leakage score。结果。 同一模型平均为 23.6%；两种继承条件为 19.3%/22.3%；同家族同系列为 8.9%；不同系列同家族仍有 2.8%（表 2）。边界。 这些是已测配置，不是闭源模型谱系可直接套用的通用校正系数。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Traditional contamination concerns item overlap, while prior LLM-judge audits emphasize length or egocentric bias. This paper changes the leakage path: related synthetic generators imprint preferences on a student that a related judge later favors. Its contribution is the three-level lineage taxonomy and measurement score, not a claim that all same-family comparisons are invalid. Generator provenance becomes an explicit evaluation variable.
传统污染关注评测项与训练数据重叠，既有 LLM judge 审计多看长度或自我偏好。本文改变泄漏路径：相关合成生成器将偏好刻入学生，相关 judge 随后偏向该学生。贡献是三层谱系分类与量化分数，不是声称所有同家族比较都无效；生成器来源因此成为显式评测变量。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper leaves detection, prevention, mitigation, and calibration for future work. This matters because closed generator and judge lineages are often unknown; the three relation labels may be impossible to establish. The study also measures selected models and benchmarks rather than every synthesis pipeline. Before reuse, record model ancestry and synthetic-data share, then compute a matched control rather than treating a low observed score as proof of no leakage.
论文将检测、预防、缓解和校准留给未来工作。闭源生成器与 judge 的谱系常未知，三类关联因而可能无法判定；研究也只覆盖选定模型和 benchmark，而非所有合成流程。复用前应记录模型祖先和合成数据占比，构造匹配对照并计算分数，不能把一次低分当作不存在泄漏的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: When selecting a judge for a model trained on synthetic preference data, inventory generator, student, and judge lineage; evaluate matched related and unrelated conditions; then report the preference leakage score alongside the main benchmark score. The output is an audit report that separates apparent improvement from lineage favoritism. It is unsuitable when neither model provenance nor a controlled comparison is available. Success requires stable conclusions under an unrelated judge, not only a high judge score.
若要为合成偏好数据训练的模型选择 judge，应盘点生成器、学生与 judge 谱系，评测关联和非关联的匹配条件，再将 preference leakage score 与主 benchmark 分数一并报告。输出是区分真实改进与谱系偏袒的审计报告。无模型来源或无受控对照时不适用；成功标准是换非关联 judge 后结论仍稳定，而非仅有高 judge 分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: it audits lineage-based preference contamination, not prompt overlap.
  • Lever: compare same-model, inheritance, and family generator--judge relations with a leakage score.
  • Artifact: official repository releases the study code and data.
  • Evidence: same-model relatedness averages 23.6% leakage; even different-series same-family relation averages 2.8%.
  • Reuse decision: require a provenance table and unrelated-judge control before claiming a synthetic-data gain.

• 定位： 审计基于谱系的偏好污染，而非提示词重叠。
  • 方法抓手： 用泄漏分数比较同一模型、继承和同家族的生成器—judge 关系。
  • 工件： 官方仓库公开研究代码和数据。
  • 证据锚点： 同一模型关联平均泄漏 23.6%，不同系列同家族仍平均 2.8%。
  • 复用决定： 宣称合成数据增益前，必须给出来源表与非关联 judge 对照。
